Class LibraryService

java.lang.Object
com.sebastiandorata.musicdashboard.service.LibraryService
@Service public class LibraryService extends Object
Thin facade for song, album, and artist retrieval.

Delegates to the underlying repositories and SongImportService. Also resolves the complete album list for an artist, falling back from the artist's direct albums relationship to albums inferred across the artist's songs when no direct relationship exists.

  • Method Details

    • getAllSongs

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public List<Song> getAllSongs()
      Returns every song in the library.

      The result is cached in memory; the first call loads from SongImportService, later calls return the cached list until invalidateCache() is called.

      Time Complexity: O(n) on a cache miss, O(1) on a cache hit.

      Returns:
      all songs in the library

    • getAllAlbums

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public List<Album> getAllAlbums()

      all albums in the library

    • getAllArtists

    • invalidateCache

      public void invalidateCache()
      Clears the cached songs, albums and artists so the next call to getAllSongs(), getAllAlbums() or getAllArtists() reloads from the database. Call this after any import or deletion.

    • resolveAlbumsForArtist

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public List<Album> resolveAlbumsForArtist(Artist artist)
      Returns every album associated with an artist, without duplicates.

      Combines the artist's direct albums relationship with the albums of the artist's songs. The artist is re-loaded by ID first so that lazy collections are read from the current database state.

      Time Complexity: O(a + s) where a = direct albums and s = songs by the artist.

      Parameters:
      artist - the artist whose albums to resolve
      Returns:
      the distinct albums, direct albums first, in encounter order

    • deleteSong

      @Transactional public void deleteSong(Long songId)
      Permanently deletes a song and everything that references it: playback history, favourites, playlist entries. Song's own artist/genre join rows are cleaned up automatically by Hibernate since Song owns those tables.
      Parameters:
      songId - the ID of the song to delete

    • deleteAlbum

      @Transactional public void deleteAlbum(Long albumId)
      Permanently deletes an album and every song it contains, cascading each song through deleteSong(Long) first so their playback history, favourites, and playlist entries are cleaned up too.
      Parameters:
      albumId - the ID of the album to delete
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if no album exists with the given ID
